SASBDB entry SASDPZ8  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDPZ8/)

Publication: Development of DNA Aptamers for Visualization of Glial Brain Tumors and Detection of Circulating Tumor Cells.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1016/j.omtn.2023.03.015

Model and fit used as deposited. The paper's full text could not be reached; the buffer
(Dulbecco PBS with Ca and Mg, no concentrations in SASBDB) is the standard recipe, cited
from supplier formulations (PAN-Biotech DPBS +Ca +Mg) in the script. Script: test/fitting_tests/SASDPZ8/.
